description: A row is in the set of failing truth-table rows exactly when its extension by false outside the combined support is a countervaluation.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.mem_counterRows.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α))
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α)
  (r : ↥(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.tableSupport Γ A) → Bool) :
  r ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.counterRows Γ A ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Countervaluation
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.extendRow
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.tableSupport Γ A) r)
      Γ A
